rule.sl:
**Uradno pismo:** **Dear Sir or Madam,** … **Yours faithfully,** Z imenom: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** … **Yours sincerely,** Američani tudi **Yours truly,** Polne oblike: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** **I would be grateful if you could reply.** **I look forward to hearing from you.** **receive**, **request**, **inform**, **require** namesto get, ask for, tell, need.

**Prošnja, pritožba:** **Could you …?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I am writing to complain about …** **I would like a refund.** **I am afraid …**

**Prijatelju:** **Hi Jack,** **Thanks for …** **Can't wait to see you!** **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Cheers**, **Love**.

**Govorjeno, razumi:** **gonna**, **gotta**, **wanna**, **dunno**, **innit**, **ta**, **cheers**, **mate**, **love**; v Cumbrii **aye**, **lad**, **lass**, **marra**. V govoru je prav, v pismu polna oblika.

**Britansko, ameriško:** **lift**, elevator; **flat**, apartment; **lorry**, truck; **petrol**, gas; **autumn**, fall; **holiday**, vacation; **chips**, fries; **pavement**, sidewalk; **colour**, color. Oboje je prav.
rule.de:
**Formeller Brief:** **Dear Sir or Madam,** … **Yours faithfully,** Mit Namen: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** … **Yours sincerely,** In Amerika auch **Yours truly,** Volle Formen: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** **I would be grateful if you could reply.** **I look forward to hearing from you.** **receive**, **request**, **inform**, **require** statt get, ask for, tell, need.

**Bitte, Beschwerde:** **Could you …?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I am writing to complain about …** **I would like a refund.** **I am afraid …**

**An Freunde:** **Hi Jack,** **Thanks for …** **Can't wait to see you!** **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Cheers**, **Love**.

**Gesprochen, zum Verstehen:** **gonna**, **gotta**, **wanna**, **dunno**, **innit**, **ta**, **cheers**, **mate**, **love**; in Cumbria **aye**, **lad**, **lass**, **marra**. Gesprochen richtig, im Brief die volle Form.

**Britisch, amerikanisch:** **lift**, elevator; **flat**, apartment; **lorry**, truck; **petrol**, gas; **autumn**, fall; **holiday**, vacation; **chips**, fries; **pavement**, sidewalk; **colour**, color. Beides ist richtig.
rule.it:
**Lettera formale:** **Dear Sir or Madam,** … **Yours faithfully,** Con il nome: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** … **Yours sincerely,** In America anche **Yours truly,** Forme estese: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** **I would be grateful if you could reply.** **I look forward to hearing from you.** **receive**, **request**, **inform**, **require** per get, ask for, tell, need.

**Richiesta, reclamo:** **Could you …?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I am writing to complain about …** **I would like a refund.** **I am afraid …**

**A un amico:** **Hi Jack,** **Thanks for …** **Can't wait to see you!** **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Cheers**, **Love**.

**Parlato, da capire:** **gonna**, **gotta**, **wanna**, **dunno**, **innit**, **ta**, **cheers**, **mate**, **love**; in Cumbria **aye**, **lad**, **lass**, **marra**. A voce va bene, in una lettera la forma estesa.

**Inglese britannico, americano:** **lift**, elevator; **flat**, apartment; **lorry**, truck; **petrol**, gas; **autumn**, fall; **holiday**, vacation; **chips**, fries; **pavement**, sidewalk; **colour**, color. Vanno bene tutti e due.
rule.en:
**A formal letter:** **Dear Sir or Madam,** … **Yours faithfully,** With a name: **Dear Mrs Birkett,** … **Yours sincerely,** In America also **Yours truly,** Whole forms: **I am writing to ask about the bus.** **I would be grateful if you could reply.** **I look forward to hearing from you.** **receive**, **request**, **inform**, **require** for get, ask for, tell, need.

**A request, a complaint:** **Could you …?** **Would you mind closing the window?** **I am writing to complain about …** **I would like a refund.** **I am afraid …**

**To a friend:** **Hi Jack,** **Thanks for …** **Can't wait to see you!** **See you soon**, **All the best**, **Cheers**, **Love**.

**Spoken, to understand:** **gonna**, **gotta**, **wanna**, **dunno**, **innit**, **ta**, **cheers**, **mate**, **love**; in Cumbria **aye**, **lad**, **lass**, **marra**. Right in talk; a letter wants the whole form.

**British, American:** **lift**, elevator; **flat**, apartment; **lorry**, truck; **petrol**, gas; **autumn**, fall; **holiday**, vacation; **chips**, fries; **pavement**, sidewalk; **colour**, color. Both are right.

tip.sl: 💡 Za nagovorom velika začetnica: **Dear Sir or Madam,** / **I am writing to …** Angleščina nima vikanja: uraden je ton, ne zaimek.
tip.de: 💡 Nach der Anrede groß, nicht klein wie im Deutschen: **Dear Sir or Madam,** / **I am writing to …** Englisch hat kein Sie: Der Ton macht es formell.
tip.it: 💡 L'inglese non ha il Lei: **you** vale per tutti, è il tono a fare la lettera formale.
tip.en: 💡 No name: **Yours faithfully**. A name: **Yours sincerely**.
